recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸片中有大型母細胞，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色，核偏位並有明顯的核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），下方一個大細胞的細胞質充滿細小顆粒；大型母細胞、灰藍細胞質與核旁淡染區是 t(8;21) AML 的典型型態。
features: Large blasts with abundant grey-blue basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Distinct pale perinuclear hof in several blasts
Fine chromatin with visible nucleoli and a few clear nuclear/cytoplasmic vacuoles
Large cell with abundant finely granular cytoplasm, reflecting abnormal maturation
Degenerating cell with vacuolated magenta cytoplasm adjacent to a red cell
Scattered small lymphocytes and normochromic red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a population of large blasts with abundant grey-blue basophilic cytoplasm, eccentrically placed nuclei with fine chromatin and nucleoli, and prominent paler perinuclear zones (hofs). A large cell with abundant finely granular cytoplasm and a degenerating vacuolated cell are also present, along with scattered small lymphocytes. Auer rods are not clearly seen in this field. The combination of large blasts with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, perinuclear hofs, and granules is characteristic of acute myeloid leukemia with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1, pending cytogenetic or molecular confirmation.

ddx.vs: Promyelocytes have bilobed or folded nuclei with dense azurophilic granules or hypogranular cytoplasm and bundles of Auer rods, and show PML::RARA.
Monoblasts have round to folded nuclei, grey-blue cytoplasm with pseudopods and vacuoles, but are NSE positive and lack perinuclear hofs.
Show eccentric nuclei with hofs but have coarse clock-face chromatin and are CD138 positive, MPO negative.
